profile.name: Yashraj Rathor
profile.intro: I’m Yashraj. I build data pipelines and intelligent systems that turn information into something useful.
profile.about:
I work at the intersection of data engineering and applied AI. From moving raw data through Azure to building retrieval systems and multi-agent workflows, I enjoy making complex systems feel clear and useful.

My background in Information Technology at SIES Graduate School of Technology grounds that curiosity in Python, SQL, and the fundamentals of software engineering.
profile.contactText: A data challenge, an interesting role, or an idea worth exploring. I’d love to hear about it.

projects.title: From raw tracks to ready-to-use data.
projects.name: Spotify Data Pipeline
projects.summary: An end-to-end Azure pipeline built around metadata-driven ingestion and a bronze-to-gold data architecture.
projects.description: A cloud data engineering project that moves Spotify data into Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 through parameterized pipelines, then prepares it for downstream use with Databricks and PySpark.
bullets: Built metadata-driven, parameterized ingestion with Azure Data Factory.
Implemented incremental loading and backfilling to reduce redundant processing.
Applied cleaning, transformation, and validation across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.

projects.title: Less searching. More understanding.
projects.name: Memora
projects.summary: A semantic learning assistant that connects educational documents to contextual answers.
projects.description: Memora is an AI-powered semantic learning system built around Retrieval-Augmented Generation. It pairs intelligent document retrieval with vector embeddings to make educational content easier to explore.
bullets: Constructed a document retrieval pipeline for educational content.
Used semantic search to improve information accessibility.
Generated contextual responses using vector embeddings and retrieved knowledge.

projects.title: One question. The right workflow.
projects.name: Agentic Data Analyst
projects.summary: A multi-agent system that routes natural-language requests into specialized SQL and ETL workflows.
projects.description: A data analyst and ETL automation system with an LLM-based router and two specialized agents. Its tool-driven workflows connect data questions with SQL execution and API-based extraction.
bullets: Designed a multi-agent architecture with specialized SQL and ETL agents.
Built a 7-stage SQL workflow covering question curation, schema discovery, generation, safety validation, PostgreSQL execution, and response generation.
Implemented API extraction and Pandas transformations with CSV, JSON, and Parquet outputs.
